steps.text: The Sarkaz stopped.
The burning ruins collapsed in towards the center. Those monstrous creatures looked down on us from above.
A woman suddenly emerged from the center of the circle. A very... strange woman.
She wasn't Sarkaz. She stood in the center of the battlefield, her expression unchanging.
Ines was trembling, but I couldn't tell you why.
The explosion must have damaged my hearing. I couldn't hear what they were saying.
But I knew they were afraid.
Was it because of her?
No, their attention was focused in another direction, on someone else.
In the seconds before I lost consciousness, I saw——
A... Sarkaz.
An unthreatening... slender Sarkaz.
They... for the moment...
Sarkaz... must...
...You will... what?
She is heavily injured... If we don't do something now...
...If... he... finds this place... We're out of time...
...Kal'tsit, give me a hand.
...*Sigh*. Fine.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Where am I...?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: On a landship.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Landship...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: How are we still alive?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: If you're gonna screw around, can you leave me out of it?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Long story short, we got rescued.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So where are we?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: The main convoy. This is the landship we were protecting. Now it's hauling our wounded.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Looks like it's still under construction. I can't tell how it all fits together. Weird.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (But the shadow I saw... It was... Some questions are better left unanswered.)

steps.name: W
steps.text: What about Hoederer?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: He's with the client... Err, he's... talking to the boss of this place.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Right. If you're still hanging around here, Hoederer must be fine.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So what's the deal with 'the boss of this place?'

steps.name: W
steps.text: You look nervous. And I don't need to blind myself with Originium Arts to figure that out.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Don't tell me you think I'm hanging out here because I care about you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Definitely not. So what's the reason?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: *Sigh.*

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I guess I just feel bad for him.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Who knows what kinds of monsters are in that room with him...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Try to relax. Nervousness will only drag down our efficiency.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You did the best you could. The leak was our fault.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: We don't really look for fault on the battlefield. I know who I'm dealing with.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But I can't say I expected that commander... to be one of Her Majesty's own.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You're... a lot stronger than I expected. I haven't had a chance to thank you yet, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa's the one you should be thanking.
What was that about me?

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Your Majesty——
We're not in Kazdel anymore. Let's not stand on ceremony. We're here to sit down and talk, Hoederer.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: By your command.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: And, the one in the coat there must be...?
I hope you don't mind. It's very important that the Doctor be well aware of any new intelligence.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Thank you for understanding.

steps.name: W
steps.text: (It really is a landship... But it's pretty big, huh...?)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (There are parts that look new, but some bits are so old they're practically falling apart...)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (I think... this is from Rim Billiton...)

steps.name: Small Cautus
steps.text: Oh! S-sorry. They're still building this place...

steps.name: Small Cautus
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit said... not to go any deeper. It's dangerous...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Uh huh...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Okay. I'll go somewhere else.

steps.name: Small Cautus
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What a nice kid. With those ears, she's definitely not Sarkaz.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Come to think of it, that one lady who sucks even more than Ines, that doctor, she isn't a Sarkaz either...

steps.name: W
steps.text: What's going on here? I look around in the middle of a battle and nobody's Sarkaz?
How could you be jammed again?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh?
Happy place, Closure. That's only the seventh short circuit today...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: THE——SEVENTH——SHORT——CIRCUIT——

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Kind of embarrassing for a genius engineer, huh? What if we invested in a new set of doors? That'd save some time!
Oh... well, we have so many wounded to care for. Their provisions are rather expensive, in both manpower and resources...
And wouldn't giving up be an even bigger embarrassment...?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Waaaahhhh——

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Okay! Your Majesty!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Give me three days! If I can't fix it in three days, I'll take the whole security control system apart and reinstall it!
Re-reinstall? You can do that?

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: I dunno who built these mysterious systems and then buried them out in Rim Billiton somewhere, then if we can't figure it out...

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: We'll just have to replace it with something we can! Easy peasy!
Well... I'll leave you to it then.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Roger that!
...*Sigh*.
Rhodes Island... how long will it be until you're up and running...?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Rhodes Island?
Oh...
You're... I remember, you were with Hoederer...
You've regained consciousness? Your wounds were quite serious.

steps.name: W
steps.text: (Did I scare her...?)

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm W, the mercenary. I'm looking for Captain Hoederer and I kinda got lost...
Be careful where you wander. This place is still being built. There are a lot of exposed wires. You could get shocked.
But I have a feeling such caution is second nature to you, no?
W, was it?
You may call me Theresa.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Hoederer had words with the Doctor after our meeting. I believe he should be back in his room in Medical by now.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Don't make them worry. You ought to head back too.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Theresa... Your Majesty?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Oh? Well, we're not in Kazdel anymore. No need for titles.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Okay, Theresa... Majesty, why were you wrestling with a door just now?

steps.name: W
steps.text: And that short girl there is an engineer, right? I mean, it's just a door...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: It's not just a door.

steps.name: W
steps.text: O... kay?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: How many things are there totally unworthy of my attention?

steps.name: W
steps.text: So what's Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Oh, you heard that.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: That is the name of this vessel. Although it has not yet been officially christened... that is the name I wish for it.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Maybe it's just my whimsy. The Doctor and Kal'tsit may reject its 'true name.'

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Heh. True name? For this landship?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You saw. This vessel wasn't built in Kazdel.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Searching deep in the oldest records we have, I came across that name...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: 'Rhodes Island.'

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I'm not actually sure what it means. Hm... Kal'tsit should know more.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But that is what I want to name it. It already had a name, after all.

steps.name: W
steps.text: (Her Majesty Theresa fought against the Regent who usurped Kazdel... She personally brought together more than half the Sarkaz clans...)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (...and she's fixing a door herself?)

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What's wrong? You have an odd expression on your face.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Would it be considered improper to laugh in front of Your Majesty?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: N-no... But neither Kal'tsit nor the Doctor are the laughing type... and the warriors have too much on their plates for such frivolity.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I would quite like it if you all would smile.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: But that is perhaps an extravagant hope. I understand the pressure I've placed on everyone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So I'm cool to laugh then?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Um, yes?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Nah, the magic's gone. Can't do it...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Why do I feel like that's my fault?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hehe... well, I wouldn't dare.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: What about you?

steps.name: W
steps.text: What about me?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I am Theresa, this is Rhodes Island, and you are?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: That's not what I mean. 'W' is a mercenary codename. I want to know your true name. The one that represents you..

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You need not cloak yourself in a disguise tainted by war. This goes beyond names. Let's just say I'm nosy.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Oh... forgive me.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You don't have a name?

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's pretty common for Sarkaz born in Kazdel.

steps.name: W
steps.text: We don't really care much for... names. People forget them all the time. What's the point in making an effort to remember a name?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: I don't want to forget them. I can't forget them.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: If you wait for the dust to settle in Kazdel... until you're no longer 'W,' we could speak like this once again.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Maybe then you could have a more fitting name. A proper name for a Sarkaz woman like yourself.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Like Rhodes Island. A name makes things feel so much warmer, doesn't it?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I never really thought about it...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Theresa, message.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Kazdel is on the move. The Doctor is getting ready.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Right, I'm on my way.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: W?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh, yeah, I'm here.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: If you are willing to fight for us still, you will always be welcome here. No matter what.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...*Sigh*.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not going to criticize Theresa's decision, but...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Don't expect too warm a welcome. I've seen your record. You're dangerous.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh. Same?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're recovering fast, but not enough to have you wandering around as you please.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Go back to bed before we have to have someone carry you there.
I realized later.
I never dared to look Theresa in the eye.
Why?
She looked so naive.
It wasn't the look of a leader at the head of one of the armies in our cruel war...
Is naive the word...?
You don't have eyes like that when you're naive... Such... sad eyes.
And those two were always at her side, it seemed.
If... if I could stand with them...
What kind of sights would I see?

steps.name: W
steps.text: (That hood... is that the 'Doctor' they were talking about?)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (Is that person... looking my way...?)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (What the... Why...?)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (Am I scared? Scared of what? That person gives off pretty normal vibes, but...? No, it's too vague. I've never seen anyone that weird before...)

steps.name: W
steps.text: (Oh... that's Babel's battlefield commander. I remember now...)

steps.name: W
steps.text: ('The Doctor,' huh?)
I'm starting to get why Ines wouldn't go near Her Majesty.
Maybe it would be better to look out for myself every once in a while.
But... I'm not sure why... Ugh, when it comes to Theresa, I never really knew why...
Call it a whim. Hoederer and the others would understand.
